record.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
record.description:
A story-rich classical CRPG set in the Koronus Expanse. Command a voidship, recruit a diverse retinue, make consequential decisions, and fight tactical turn-based battles in the Warhammer 40,000 universe.

As a Rogue Trader, the player leads a powerful dynasty operating beyond the strict boundaries of Imperial space. The Koronus Expanse is full of heresy, political conflict, xenos threats and ancient secrets. Companion loyalties and the player's ideology shape relationships and outcomes over a long campaign. Narrative choices can significantly influence the fate of the dynasty and the regions it touches.

record.description_short: A story-driven action RPG following Rex and Pyra across the Titans of Alrest in search of Elysium.
record.description_ar: قاد ريكس وبايرا ورفاقهما عبر عالم ألريست بحثًا عن Elysium. استكشف العمالقة الأحياء، واجمع الـBlades وطوّرها، وأتقن نظام قتال متدرج وعميق، مع توسعة رسمية كبيرة تتضمن Torna ~ The Golden Country.
record.nintendoNotes:
Official platform status: Nintendo Switch version released 2017-12-01. Native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition released digitally on 2026-07-30; Nintendo lists 4K TV / full-HD handheld at 60 fps plus MOMO, Merc Assault and new Pyra/Mythra outfit designs.

Supplier language selection: Simplified Chinese. Four supplier variants per platform are mapped using the established rule: Regular=Offline Standard; Special=Offline DLC; Standard=Online Standard; Deluxe=Online DLC.
NS1: ¥6.8 / ¥11.7 / ¥95 / ¥114.6 => 1,250 / 2,500 / 20,750 / 25,000 IQD.
NS2: ¥16.6 / ¥21.5 / ¥114.6 / ¥124.4 => 3,500 / 4,500 / 25,000 / 27,250 IQD.
Dual-platform type.cost fields are left blank because the template cannot encode two platform costs safely.

gameplayPillars.title: Driver and Blade combat
gameplayPillars.description: Drivers fight alongside Blades, combining Arts, Specials, elemental routes, Driver Combos, Blade Combos, and Chain Attacks.

gameplayPillars.title: Explore the Titans
gameplayPillars.description: The Titans function as large adventure regions filled with quests, enemies, collection points, landmarks, towns, and hidden paths.

gameplayPillars.title: Build affinity and teams
gameplayPillars.description: Blade affinity charts, equipment, Aux Cores, pouch items, roles, elements, and party composition create a large customization layer.

record.worldSummary: Alrest is a cloud-covered world where civilizations live on the backs of enormous Titans. Each Titan has distinctive terrain, settlements, wildlife, politics, and routes that change the shape of exploration.

storyChapters.title: Rex and Pyra
storyChapters.body: Rex forms a bond with Pyra and accepts her request to reach Elysium, drawing him into a conflict involving Drivers, Blades, and rival powers.

storyChapters.title: The search for Elysium
storyChapters.body: The party journeys between Titans as dwindling land and political tension push Alrest toward crisis.

storyChapters.title: Conflict over Alrest’s future
storyChapters.body: The search for Elysium reveals deeper truths about Blades, Titans, and the history that shaped Alrest.

record.perfNotes: Original Switch: docked 720p with a 30 fps target and occasional dips; handheld uses aggressive dynamic resolution roughly 368p-552p. Switch 2 Edition: official 4K TV / 1080p handheld output at 60 fps; measured internal resolution is lower and temporally upscaled.
record.storageNotes: Nintendo lists 13.2 GB for the Switch game and 37.6 GB for the Switch 2 Edition.

record.verdictSummary: A large, ambitious JRPG with a memorable cast, expansive world design, and an unusually deep combat/build system. The Switch 2 Edition substantially improves image clarity and frame rate.
